original_column_name:
Age group  
○Neonates (≤28 days) 
○ Infants (29-365 days) 
○ Children (1-18 years)

Underlying conditions 
e.g. Congenital heart disease, Sepsis, Resp failure

Model type 
○ Logistic regression (baseline comparator) 
○ Random forest 
○ Neural network 
○ Gradient boosting 
○ Deep learning architectures

Input data modality: 
- Vital signs
- ECG
- Labs
- Multimodal
Prediction lead time: E.g., 1h, 6h, 12h before arrest

Thematic analysis: 
- Vital signs (HR, RR, BP, SpO2) 
- Lab values 
- Demographic (even if later excluded analytically) 
- Clinical events

Comparator Data 
Where available: 
- PEWS 
- Other monitoring systems 
 + their respective TP/FP/FN/TN, sensitivity, specificity, AUROC

Risk of bias/quality (QUADAS-2 inputs) 
- Patient selection criteria 
- Index test (ML model) 
- Reference standard (definition of cardiac arrest) 
- Flow and timing 
Note: 
- Missing data handling  
- Blinding (if any is blinded)

Meta-regression: 
Covariates: 
- Mean/median age 
-  % neonates 
- Prevalence of cardiac arrest 
- % congenital heart disease 
 For heterogeneity: 
- Threshold used 
- Data imbalance handling (oversampling, etc) 
- Study setting differences
